title: Emergent Relational Order in LLM Agent Societies: From Collective Affect to Authority Stratification
reasoning: The paper explicitly incorporates 'Ethical Resonator' and 'Moral Judgment' modules based on Durkheimian ethics into its LLM agent architecture (CAREB-MAS). It evaluates 'Guanxi as Economic Ethics' and specifically studies how ethical judgment and moral constraints shape social structure and authority in agent simulations.
